description: This file defines the code-behind class for the Index Razor Page in an ASP.NET Core application. It manages the data retrieval for the catalog view on the index page, utilizing a catalog service to fetch catalog items based on page number and filters.

classes.name: IndexModel
classes.description: Page model class for the Index Razor Page, handling catalog item retrieval and page interactions.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests for the index page, retrieving catalog items with optional filtering and pagination.
